registered_before: any with/without-rules comparison number and any paged-level number (none has been computed)
owner_decision: 22/10: finish ML first, then integrate the rule-based parts and compare the system without and with them
when: only after ML is complete: (1) the stable ML configuration is frozen (stable-selection-v1 step 4), (2) burden-reduction-v1 is decided (proposed lever adopted or not after its blind test), (3) the confirmation live run of that configuration is finished. Until then no rule-tier number is computed; rule_tier.py is not run.

arms.A_ml_only: the stable ML configuration alone (the thesis numbers for the detector)
arms.B1_ml_plus_falco: ML and Falco as parallel alert streams
arms.B2_ml_plus_tripwire: ML and tripwire A1 as parallel alert streams
arms.B3_ml_plus_probe_triage: ML previews filtered for paging by the post-ML probe triage (definitions of rule-integration-v1, unchanged)
arms.B_all: ML + Falco + tripwire in parallel, ML part after probe triage
arms.later: rule-first orderings only if the owner decides so after ML is stable; registered separately

data.primary: the confirmation live run (fresh campaign, blind for every arm)
data.secondary: pulse-stable-candidate and pulse-stable-refreshed (development; Falco only per-arm aggregates there, its raw logs were deleted)

metrics_per_arm: recall per scenario and overall, precision, idle-control rate, benign-launch rate
p95 kernel -> first alert of the arm (parallel streams: first alert of any stream; triage: preview time + time to the triage decision)
alerts to humans per replica-hour on normal: streams added; alerts of one container less than 15 s apart merged across streams
added cost: rule maintenance (exceptions), evasion notes
comparison: every B arm against A on the same trials and the same normal span: paired per-trial differences (recall, control, benign) with a workload-clustered bootstrap 95 % CI; burden difference with the same bootstrap; latency difference of p95 with a bootstrap over trials
capture_requirements_for_the_confirmatio: keep Falco logs until the per-trial and per-event comparison is written (falco_baseline.py must emit per-trial outcomes and event times)
tripwire A1 on the run's own normal: reference span before the campaign, alerts counted on the normal after it
RCA running with the triage label on every case; report the share of ML episodes without a case (fail-open)
